The code changes involve significant modifications to the `EsRelation` and `EsQueryExec` classes, primarily focusing on removing the serialization of `EsIndex` objects in favor of using a string representation for the index name. Here are some observations:
- The removal of `frozen` from `EsRelation` seems intentional based on the context but should be confirmed if it was part of the original design or an oversight.
- The changes to `EsRelation` and `EsQueryExec` constructors and methods to accommodate the new string-based index name representation are consistent across multiple files, indicating a thorough refactoring effort. However, this change could introduce issues if not all instances where `EsIndex` was used have been updated accordingly.
- The serialization logic in `readFrom` and `writeTo` methods of `EsRelation` and `EsQueryExec` has been adjusted to handle the new transport version conditionally, which is a good practice for maintaining backward compatibility. However, it's crucial that all test cases cover both old and new serialization formats.
- The removal of `index()` method in favor of `indexName()` and `indexNameWithModes()` methods in `EsRelation` and similar changes in `EsQueryExec` are consistent with the refactoring goal but require careful review to ensure no other parts of the codebase rely on the old method signatures.

review_comment:
I believe the `indexMode` attribute has become obsolete. It's required in the `UnresolvedRelation`, but if we keep track of `indexNameWithModes`, the latter has more complete information _obtained from actual field caps calls_ and should be preferred.

I think we only use this `indexMode` to check if a relation corresponds to a lookup index. I think we could just have a helper function instead `isLookupIndex` which checks the `indexNameWithModes`.
Let me try to replace its usages with the map

We also have 2 checks for `TIME_SERIES`:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/ab2607783a18daf375f61c24b93fc2294c653608/x-pack/plugin/esql/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/esql/optimizer/rules/physical/local/ReplaceSourceAttributes.java#L35

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/d953079380243f518ca3847fdcb4e1816a4c8163/x-pack/plugin/esql/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/esql/planner/EsPhysicalOperationProviders.java#L184

that is originally configured in:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/212e16bc3a5f6bef412f2ba158d5ace7f62ea300/x-pack/plugin/esql/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/esql/parser/LogicalPlanBuilder.java#L484

I am thinking of deferring that to a separate change
I opened an issue for that https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/120210
